readingDescription: We read the document, find the vocabulary, grammar, calligraphy and exercises, and show you everything to check next to the original page. Nothing is added until you confirm.
sourceStepHeading: Where does this document come from?
levelApplied: Applied to every lesson created from this document.
pagesHint: Leave empty to read the whole document. For a long book, pick just the pages of this lesson: it is faster and cheaper, because each page is one call to your text model.
lookThroughDocument: Look through the document to find your pages
handwrittenWarning: Handwriting is read best by a vision model and you haven't added one, so expect many items to need checking.
findingContent: Finding vocabulary, grammar, calligraphy and exercises…
confirmPageKindsDescription: We detected which kinds of content are on each page. Review and edit as needed, then continue to extraction.
importTakesTime: This can take several minutes for a long scan. You can leave this page: find the import under "Imports" in the top bar.
taggedWithSource: They are tagged with the source "{sourceTitle}".
notesFromImport: {count, plural, one {# note} other {# notes}} from the import
foundStatistics: {total} found · {verified} found in the text · {flagged} need your check · {selected} to add
reviewExplanation: Only items you confirm are added. "Found in the text" means the item and its quote appear in the document; anything written by the model starts unconfirmed: compare it with the page.
nothingFound: Nothing was found here: no vocabulary, grammar, calligraphy or exercises.
audioClips: Make the {count, plural, one {# missing audio clip} other {# missing audio clips}} with my text-to-speech endpoint (one call per clip)
audioClipsDisabled: Add a text-to-speech endpoint in Settings to turn this on.
incompleteConfirmed: {count, plural, one {# confirmed card is missing required text (word, title, explanation, one character, question or answer) and would not be added.} other {# confirmed cards are missing required text (word, title, explanation, one character, question or answer) and would not be added.}} Fix or delete {count, plural, one {it} other {them}}.
generatedBadgeTitle: Written by the model from the page text - check it
generatedTranslationTitle: The document gave no translation; the model wrote this one
generatedAnswerTitle: The model wrote this answer, not found in the document
title: Title
question: Question
skipped: Nothing here or contents page - skipped
openInNewTab: Open the document in a new tab
pictureFound: Picture found next to this item
addItAsImage: Add it as the support image
couldNotCheckSettings: Couldn't check your settings - reload the page to try again.
audioSummaryTts: Audio: {count, plural, one {# clip} other {# clips}} - made with your text-to-speech endpoint when you add the lesson, unless you replace a clip
audioSummaryNoTts: Audio: {count, plural, one {# clip} other {# clips}} - no text-to-speech endpoint is set up, so add your own clips or leave it without sound
couldNotAddItems: Could not add the selected items
originalPageAltLong: The original page {page} of the document
chooseFileFirst: Choose a PDF or an image first
structureIntro: We looked at the top of every page to guess where each lesson starts. Check the titles and page numbers, rename, untick or add lessons, then continue. Pages {first}-{last} were read; pages outside a lesson are skipped.
titleOnFirstPage: This title appears on its first page
titleNotOnFirstPage: Not found on its first page
lessonsSummary: {included, plural, one {# lesson} other {# lessons}} · up to {calls, plural, one {# model call} other {# model calls}} (one per page; pages without text cost nothing). The calls use your own text endpoint.
extractContentOfLessons: Extract the content of {count, plural, one {# lesson} other {# lessons}}
lessonsProgress: {ready} of {total} lessons ready · {added} added to "{languageName}"{reading, select, yes { · still reading the rest…} other {}}
reviewEachLesson: Review each lesson and add it when you are happy. Nothing is created until you press "Add".
lessonCouldNotBeRead: This lesson could not be read.
lessonNotReadYet: This lesson has not been read yet.
lessonAddedCount: Added {count, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}}.
languageImportTakesTime: Reading a long scan takes a few minutes. You can leave this page: the import is listed under "Imports" in the top bar.
pagesRead: {done} of {total, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}} read
